note: Town of Olds campground leased to and run by the Olds Lions Club, on 54 Street across from the agricultural society fairgrounds and next to Centennial Park's skatepark and splash park. Fenced and gated, with a picnic table and fire pit at each site and a keypad-locked toilet building at the south end. Livestock and horse trailers are not allowed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 2024 rates C$25 pull-through / C$40 power+water (+GST), 47 sites, May 1 - Oct 15, phone booking; added dump, wifi; note cleaned.
